scoreboard.jpg.description: Wimbledon 2010. On court 16, a score board shows the score of the match between Nicolas Mahut and John Isner : 51-50 in the 5th set, match in progress. It's 8.03 pm and both players have already played during 8h53 at this stage of the match (which they started the previous day and will eventually finish the day after, 70-68 in the 5th set).
